about: The economy rehearsal's calibration (Crafting 2.0 WP10). Measured numbers are docs/CRAFTING-M0-FINDINGS.md section 4 (the owner's 0.37b test world: database snapshots of 2026-11-09/11 and the PC logs of 2026-11-14/15, about 3,080 bots); every other number is marked assumed with where it came from. Aggregates only; no player data. Copper throughout (1 gold = 10,000 copper).
source: CRAFTING-M0-FINDINGS.md 4 (integration/2.0 @ c58ea66e1 code, 0.37b test world); assumptions as marked

bands.note: assumed: the 21-30 rates (M0 has no sample below 21)
M0 4: median kills/hour, 45 solo and 75 group bots
M0 4: 24 solo bots; group had one bot, the 31-40 group rate is used (assumed)

coin.formula: 2 + (L+1)^3/8 copper, plus up to half again, x money_drop (LootGeneratorMoney; M0 4)
coin.grossNote: M0 4, the two rows above multiplied; the rehearsal reports its own gross rate per band against these

groups.note: assumed: M0 4 sampled 528 group and 707 solo PvE bots (about 0.43 grouped); the group size is a guess. A group kill's coin is split between the members.

loot.rogNote: measured in code: AtlasMobLoot 14% + 10% solo bonus; group per member 14% minus 3 above 27 and 3 more above 40 (persona_sim data check 2026-10-11)
loot.rogUtilityNote: assumed from CapUtility: about (level - 7) x 0.8-1.05, floor 15 (persona_sim)
loot.trashNote: assumed: plain loot sold to a vendor at a task break, as a share of the kill coin (persona_sim's vendor_loot was about 0.12 of hunting income)

shopping.note: M0 4: per hour 99 Exchange buys (93% by level 50s), 54 vendor buys, 9 merchant-service buys for about 3,080 bots, of which about 37% are level 50 (database sample). In the rehearsal these are attempts; a bot buys only an affordable upgrade, so its realized rates are reported against the observed ones.
shopping.servicePriceNote: assumed: a dye or similar service (AutonomousBotCosmetics buys real dye templates; 20 silver is a guess)
shopping.listingNote: measured in code: RollListingPrice -0.35..+0.50; an unsold bot listing is deleted after 24 h (RealmExchangeExpiry, the WP0 seam's default)

travel.note: assumed: a stable ticket on a quarter of task breaks at 5 silver (not logged; M0 4 'not measurable')

time.note: town breaks 15-30 minutes x the personality's length factor and chance (AutonomousBotPersonality, in code); task length assumed

leveling.note: assumed: living_world_sim.py's hours_to_level(L) = 0.045 x 1.135^L at bot_xp 1.0 (living-world/trade-sim), about 186 hours from 1 to 50

agedWorld.note: M0 4: purses at the 11-09 snapshot (the level 50 median includes the launcher's 10,000 gold); level shares from the kill-speed sample counts, 1-20 assumed; the spread (lognormal sigma) is assumed

observed.note: M0 4, for comparison only: 245 loot upgrades an hour for about 3,080 bots; the median net purse change over 56 wall-clock hours (server uptime unknown, so it is a lower bound on any hourly rate)

crafting.note: the WP0 rules stand-in (Adapters/WP0CraftRulesStandIn.cs): player pace, a session per town break; the capital bonus (GamePlayer.CraftingSkillBonus) is assumed 0; item_sell_ratio is the server default 50

gates.note: the plan's gates (CRAFTING-2.0-BUILD-PLAN 3.2 of the planner's plan). Supply growth: an aged world may grow by at most this percent in a week; a fresh world (supply near 0) by at most this much gold per bot-hour. Both are wide on purpose until WP2's soak measures the real net rate; tighten them then.
